principle_violations.reason: The AreaCalculator class has multiple responsibilities: storing shapes and calculating areas. It should only focus on area calculations.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the responsibility of managing the shapes into a separate class called ShapeManager.

principle_violations.reason: The SumCalculator is handling multiple types of output formats (HTML and JSON) which may require different implementations in the future. It should implement separate calculators for each output format instead.
principle_violations.suggestion: Create separate classes for each output format, such as HTMLSumCalculator and JSONSumCalculator, which extend from a common interface.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
